sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 280. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Nullifies Cost reduction for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 100 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
